reducer._query._parse_value must return tuple[str, PredicateValue] so callers receive correctly-shaped predicate values; reducer._filters.apply_ticket_filters and reducer.search.search_states must be verified as consumers conforming to the contract
rebar.reducer.* must be promoted to tier-1 typing ratchet override in pyproject.toml and _RATCHET_BASELINE in tests/unit/test_mypy_ratchet.py
Existing reducer filter/query/search behavior and tests must remain unchanged after typing refactor
